target_customer: Vintage stores and online resellers (eBay, Vinted, Depop sellers) buying wholesale secondhand clothing
problem: Resellers sourced bulk used clothing through fragmented offline relationships with wholesalers and rag houses; suppliers had no efficient way to reach global buyers.
business_model: B2B marketplace with commission on transactions between wholesalers and retailers

founders.name: Abhi Arora
previous_startups: Video AI startup for media creators
founders.background_notes: Early employee at Dubsmash and led growth there before the Reddit acquisition.

founders.name: Sanket Agarwal
founders.background_notes: Founding engineer at Suki; later led a 30 person consumer and marketing engineering org.

technical_complexity.rationale: Two sided marketplace with payments, credit terms, cross border shipping and customs for bundles; operationally hard, technically standard, with AI grading and sorting added later.

defensibility.rationale: Supplier base of over 1,000 wholesalers mainly in Pakistan, India and Dubai plus thousands of buyers created supply and demand liquidity, but buyers could still source offline.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large resale marketplaces focused on consumer to consumer sales; none shipped a wholesale vintage product. eBay later invested in Fleek's 2026 Series B.

market_need_then: Secondhand fashion was booming among Gen Z and millennials in 2021 to 2022, and resellers lacked a reliable digital wholesale source; the founders cite a relative's struggle sourcing stock.

branding.domain_note: Operates at joinfleek.com, not an exact fleek.com; other companies share the name Fleek.

identity.logo: Black wordmark with a transparent background variant
identity.visual_style: Mobile app first, bundle video picks
identity.voice_and_tone: Upbeat and reseller focused, with lines like Real resellers. Real results.

branding.community_and_virality: Marketed through reseller testimonials from eBay, Vinted and Depop sellers and press (FT, TechCrunch); no mascot or merch found.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear niche positioning with reseller testimonials and notable press, but the name is shared with other companies and no iconic brand asset was found.

outcome_analysis: Fleek rode the secondhand fashion boom by digitising wholesale sourcing for resellers, growing from a London start to over 2,000 suppliers and 45,000 or more buyers by 2026. It raised a seed, a 14.8 million Series A in 2024 led by HV Capital, and a 25 million Series B in 2026 led by Burda with eBay participating, for about 45 million in total. Its edge is supply liquidity and trust features such as buyer protection and credit terms rather than technology.
notes: Seed date is not stated in sources (first disclosed Nov 2024), so it is left null. Total of about 45 million comes from Series B coverage. Valuations not disclosed. No dated competitor sources near the March 2022 launch were found; TechCrunch 2024 names no direct competitors. Revenue figure on one aggregator is ignored as unverified. Supplier counts differ across outlets (1,000 in 2024, 2,000 in 2026), consistent with growth.
